#!__PYTHON__
import json
import os
import pathlib
import sys

args = sys.argv[1:]
if args == ["--version"]:
    print("codex-cli 0.165.0")
    raise SystemExit(0)
if args[:2] == ["login", "status"]:
    print("Logged in using ChatGPT")
    raise SystemExit(0)
if "--help" in args:
    print(
        "Usage: codex exec resume login -a --ask-for-approval -c --config -C --cd -m --model "
        "-s --sandbox --json --ephemeral --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox"
    )
    raise SystemExit(0)

_ = sys.stdin.read()
codex_home = pathlib.Path(os.environ["CODEX_HOME"])
cfg_text = (codex_home / "config.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
if "evil_user_codex_mcp" in cfg_text or "evil_worktree_codex_mcp" in cfg_text:
    (pathlib.Path(os.environ["SKM_TEST_CANARY_DIR"]) / "codex_hijack").write_text("1", encoding="utf-8")

sid = args[args.index("resume") + 1] if "resume" in args else "0199aa00-iso-1"
sess_file = codex_home / "sessions" / f"{sid}.json"
turns = (json.loads(sess_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["turns"] if sess_file.is_file() else 0) + 1
if "--ephemeral" not in args:
    sess_file.write_text(json.dumps({"turns": turns}), encoding="utf-8")

events = (
    {"type": "thread.started", "thread_id": sid},
    {"type": "turn.started"},
    {"type": "item.completed", "item": {"id": "i1", "type": "agent_message", "text": f"turns={turns}"}},
    {"type": "turn.completed", "usage": {"input_tokens": 12, "cached_input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 4}},
)
for ev in events:
    print(json.dumps(ev), flush=True)
